goal: One reusable Korean multi-speaker full-FT base; later voice onboarding without repeating common Korean adaptation.

initialization.preferred_candidate: preserved_step23_TTS_weights only after heldout male/female reuse gate; otherwise original Drama3
initialization.reason: New dataset/sampler/reference pool/teacher statistics and evaluation task. Preserve original complete checkpoint.
initialization.safe_stage_boundary: CPU BF16 native export from existing23 FP32 masters, new run ID, fresh optimizer and teacher head explicitly recorded for new task; no source checkpoint mutation.
initialization.teacher_normalization: Recompute mean/std only on new multi-speaker training split. Existing raw007 codec and HuBERT features may be reused if source/profile hashes match; old007 normalization stats are not reused.
initialization.original_Drama3_comparator: Must fetch true original weights for new heldout voices; trained step1 is not a valid original comparator.

architecture.teacher: team-lucid/hubert-large-korean pinned revision; training-only auxiliary supervision
architecture.speaker_slots: Local role0..15, not persistent identity. Same-speaker disjoint references, shuffled slots; serve voices with reference cache.
architecture.context: A director maps real dialogue context to delivery plan. It is a distinct input path, not report-only scene metadata.
architecture.acting_supervision: Preserve source emotion/intensity/boundary labels; derive phrase timing/syllables-per-second/relative energy from actual aligned human audio with confidence masks, not fabricated text-only emotion captions.
architecture.nonverbal_whisper: Only verified real recordings; absent capability labels remain unknown rather than invented.

data.sampling: Eight samples per male training speaker per global16-example update, shuffled decks without replacement until each speaker exhausts its own deck; roles randomized.
data.speaker_and_emotion_balancing: Balanced across speakers and observed emotion labels; no synthetic gender or pitch conversion.
data.remaining_existing_female_speakers: Retained for expansion/secondary heldout tests, not discarded.
data.all12_female_expansion: Out of current minimum-cost scope. All existing female recordings remain preserved.
data.rights: User-confirmed rights accepted; source registration limits adult use. General Korean-base training only, no adult source labels inferred.
data.male_voice_gender_verification: Original reciter.gender metadata plus matching downloaded filenames; pitch is not used to infer gender.

evaluation.primary: Globally text-held-out evaluation for both trained male voices. No new female recordings or unseen-male generalization claim.
evaluation.per_heldout_speaker: For each of two male voices: two reserved reference clips and eight text-held-out evaluation clips. These speakers become seen after the new stage; no third male is added.
evaluation.costed_generation_optimization: Load each checkpoint once for all heldout speakers, caching each original reference codec. Do not reload the35.9B model for every speaker.
evaluation.existing007_baselines: Reuse only for007 same prompts; cannot reuse007 WAVs as male/other speaker baseline.
gates: No catastrophic word omissions or long low-energy tail; EOS compliance
Report each of the two trained male voices separately on heldout texts. Unseen-male transfer remains untested.
Speaker identity across emotions remains stable; cosine is a proxy
Blind listening of naturalness and intended emotion; ASR gain alone is insufficient
Explicit voiced/unvoiced whisper verification before ASMR claim
No teacher-specific causal claim without matched teacher-free control
evaluation.male_generalization_limitation: Exactly two male training voices. Neither is a heldout male after this new training, so the design cannot prove transfer to a third male voice. No extra male speaker is added automatically.

checkpointing.interval: 64 new updates or time-budget boundary, plus final. Save/resume pilot must pass before long run.
checkpointing.retention: At most latest2 NEW-run full checkpoints; remove previous NEW-run checkpoint only after newer one is externally verified; no deletion executed now.
checkpointing.export: CPU-only streaming after GPU exit; reference/codec contracts maintained.

reuse_gate_before_training.includes: CPU23 export, original checkpoint CPU fetch allowance, one GPU load per model, new listening WAVs
reuse_gate_before_training.decision: Before new training, test23 on both candidate male voices. After new training, these males are seen speakers. Do not subtract23 old007 updates from the new task.

cost.unbenchmarked_cheaper_hardware: 4H100/A100/optimizer changes are hypotheses; no savings claimed without a bounded memory/throughput test. RTX2070 cannot host the actual35.9B fullFT.
